title: Add RecipeDiscovery scanner
description: Create CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipeDiscovery.swift with a FolderSection struct (name: String, recipes: [RecipeFile]) and a scan(folderURL:) function. Scans only the top level of the given folder URL: .cook files directly under the root go into a '(no folder)' section sorted last; each immediate subdirectory becomes its own named section. Hidden entries (names starting with '.') are skipped. Sections sorted alphabetically; recipes within each section sorted case-insensitively. Security-scoped resource access must be bracketed.
acceptance_criteria: CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipeDiscovery.swift exists
FolderSection struct has name: String and recipes: [RecipeFile]
Root-level .cook files appear in a section named '(no folder)' sorted last
Immediate subdirectories each produce one named section
No recursion beyond one level — subdirectories of subdirectories are ignored
Hidden files and dotfolders (leading '.') are skipped
Only .cook files included (case-insensitive extension check)
Sections sorted alphabetically; '(no folder)' always last
Recipes within each section sorted alphabetically case-insensitively
startAccessingSecurityScopedResource / stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource brackets every read

handoff_summary.completed: Implemented RecipeDiscovery.swift with FolderSection struct and scan(folderURL:) function per spec. Security-scoped access is bracketed with didStartAccess guard and defer cleanup. Named sections are sorted alphabetically; (no folder) is always appended last. Recipes within each section are sorted case-insensitively by displayName. No recursion beyond one level. Hidden entries filtered by both .skipsHiddenFiles option and explicit hasPrefix(".") guard.
handoff_summary.remaining: Tester bead should write RecipeDiscoveryTests.swift against a temporary fixture directory per the spec's test requirements.
handoff_summary.risks: RecipeFile.swift uses a memberwise initialiser (url:thumbnailURL:) — if that signature changes in a sibling bead, RecipeDiscovery.swift will need updating. The thumbnailURL search in findThumbnail runs outside security-scoped access for files in subdirectories; since they are children of the already-scoped folder URL this is correct, but worth noting for any future sandboxing changes.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should create CookbookAppTests/RecipeDiscoveryTests.swift using Swift Testing against a temporary fixture directory.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No conflicts expected. RecipeDiscovery.swift is a new file with no overlap with other in-progress beads.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used a caseless enum (RecipeDiscovery) as a namespace for static functions — idiomatic Swift for utility namespaces with no instances. The noFolderSectionName constant is public so UI code can reference it without magic strings. Empty subdirectories still produce a named FolderSection per the acceptance criteria wording ("each produce one named section").
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests written here — that is the tester bead's responsibility. Spec test fixture: 2 subdirs with mixed .cook/non-.cook, 1 root .cook, 1 hidden dir, 1 non-.cook file.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: findThumbnail checks only exact lowercase extensions (jpg, jpeg, png, heic); mixed-case extensions like .JPG would be missed. Case-insensitive thumbnail lookup is deferred — acceptable per spec which specifies case-insensitive but does not mandate exhaustive casing.

conflict_risks: No conflicts expected. RecipeDiscovery.swift is a new file with no overlap with other in-progress beads.
